lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Long arm (1/2) to sloped middle (5/6), measured about 45.3 deg. At 25/50/75% sections the line sits on the outermost point of the convex (outer) skin within 0.05 mm; the inner skin is 6.4 mm deeper along the bisector, which matches the plate thickness. It is parallel to the fold axis. It runs 24.2 mm of the 25.4 mm visible fold width, about 95%.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Sloped middle (5/6) to short end arm with holes (7/8), measured about 44.7 deg, opposite sense to B1 (the second bend of the joggle). At 25/50/75% sections the line sits on the outermost point of the convex outer skin within 0.02 mm, and the inner skin is about 6.3 mm deeper. It is parallel to the fold axis. It runs 23.1 mm of the 25.2 mm visible fold width, about 92%. The holes are clear of the fold arc.
